title: Plex collections in the sidebar
summary: List the server-curated Plex collections of the Movies section in the sidebar; opening one shows its films as a merge row. Measured against the real servers 2026-10-11.

questions.q: Apollo only, or every server merged by collection title?
questions.why: Maverick carries the same Kometa set; merging is the existing one-entry-per-film shape.

questions.q: Drop collections with fewer than N films in total?
questions.why: Both servers hold one-film junk collections named after disc rips, plus empty vSports ones.

rows.text: GET /library/sections/{key}/collections works: Apollo Movies 66, Apollo 4K 52, Apollo LQ 1, Apollo vSports 81 (junk); Maverick Movies 46, Archive 51, Foreign 1.

/library/sections/{key}/all?collection=<ratingKey> returns totalSize=0 on every library: the filter does NOT work with a ratingKey. Use /library/collections/{ratingKey}/children, which honours X-Plex-Container-Start/Size, returns totalSize, Guid with includeGuids=1, and Media.
Handoff guid check: /library/all?guid=tmdb://27205 returns 0 on Apollo though Inception is there carrying tmdb://27205; its plex:// guid returns 2. Discovery bug confirmed.
rowModel.merged(title, parts, fetch) with hand-built MergePart[]; loadKids is the closest loader; sidebar modes() and activate() kinds.
